changes.to: Woowa Brothers' own robot site (robot.baemin.com) describes Dilly only in service terms and publishes no specification table. The figures kept here (width 625 mm, 20 kg payload, 9 km/h, max mass 106.5 kg, 15 deg grade) are from the KIRIA outdoor-operation safety certificate record, not a maker page. The maker's 3 Aug 2026 announcement covers a newer variant, Dilly X3-R 1.4 (<100 kg total, up to 15 km/h, 2 km service radius, EPP body), and gives no table either.
